acceptanceCriteria: Root cause identified (sandbox writable roots vs corvint-tasks store routing vs role selection).

Either the review recipe/plugin refuses corvint-tasks mutations under a read-only review, or corvint-tasks refuses an OWNER-role mutation without an explicit owner binding; a test or recorded reproduction shows the refusal.
The V1-1375 operator note written by the review is reviewed and superseded or confirmed by the owner.
body: suspected: Observed 2026-10-15 in the V1-1375/1334 lane (PR #938). The lane's single Codex review (codex exec -s read-only, from the lane clone) ran `corvint-tasks ticket note set ticket:corvint:main:V1-1375 --role OWNER` in /Users/russelllewis/projects/corvint; it succeeded as receipt .git/taskman/receipts/000000006212.json (MUTATION, actor russelllewis role OWNER, ticket revision 2, 17:42 local). Expected: a read-only review cannot mutate the native store and never claims the OWNER role. Actual: mutation recorded as OWNER. Possible causes: corvint-tasks resolves the primary checkout outside the sandbox's writable roots, or the sandbox does not cover .git/taskman; the review prompt did not forbid corvint-tasks.
